parts.text:
Read draft.txt and edit it using edit_file. Make the opening sentence more welcoming and add the exact phrase 'repairs are free'. Preserve Saturday, 10 a.m., and 'bring a broken lamp'. Return a short account of your actual edit.
Previous completed handoff: The draft.txt file has been created with the announcement.

response.result: Join us this Saturday for our monthly Repair Cafe! Bring your broken household items, from toasters to lamps, and our volunteer repair experts will help you fix them. The cafe opens at 10 a.m. sharp, so don't be late! It's a great way to save money and reduce waste.

parts.text: You are the editor in a bounded writing workflow. Follow the user's exact file and role instructions. Be concise.

functionDeclarations.description: Replace exactly one non-overlapping exact anchor. Refuse zero or multiple matches; read the file and choose a unique anchor.
functionDeclarations.name: edit_file

new_text.description: Replacement; empty text deletes the anchor. Identical text succeeds as a no-op.

path.description: File path, relative to the Agent workspace or absolute; not confined to workspace.

functionDeclarations.description: Read an inclusive one-based line range; report I/O and range errors.
functionDeclarations.name: read_file

end_line.description: Last line; default 0 reads through EOF.

max_bytes.description: Maximum retained bytes; defaults to 65536. Omitted content is marked truncated.

path.description: File path, relative to the Agent workspace or absolute; not confined to workspace.

functionDeclarations.description: Create a file and missing parents. Refuse replacing an existing file without overwrite:true; append mode creates or appends.
functionDeclarations.name: write_file

append.description: Append or create; default false. When true, overwrite is irrelevant.

content.description: Exact text to write; empty text is valid.

overwrite.description: Allow replacement of existing bytes; default false.

path.description: File path, relative to the Agent workspace or absolute; not confined to workspace.
